    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    index = 0
    t = int(data[index])
    index += 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(t):
        m = int(data[index])
        index += 1
        row1 = list(map(int, data[index:index + m]))
        index += m
        row2 = list(map(int, data[index:index + m]))
        index += m
        
        dp = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(2)]
        
        dp[0][1] = row1[0]
        dp[1][1] = row2[0]
        
        for j in range(2, m + 1):
            dp[0][j] = dp[0][j - 1] + row1[j - 1]
            dp[1][j] = dp[1][j - 1] + row2[j - 1]
        
        min_score = float('inf')
        for j in range(1, m + 1):
            min_score = min(min_score, max(dp[0][j] - row1[j - 1] + dp[1][m] - dp[1][j], dp[1][j] - row2[j - 1] + dp[0][m] - dp[0][j]))
        
        results.append(min_score)
    
    print('\n'.join(map(str, results)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
